description:
Mast, dressed in the pirate costume of her dreams, makes her appearance at the Maid Cafe, leaving people unsure whether she's a pirate, a maid, or simply a bashful girl.
Despite all this confusion, the dream she holds in her heart is as genuine as it gets.

lines.text: Hahaha! How about that! I've finally become a pirate!

Just because I've become a pirate doesn't mean I'm done dreaming.
Onward to the next dream!
A spell to make it delicious...? No way a pirate would do something so ridiculous!
Do you prefer maids to pirates, Master Captain?
So, what are your dreams, Master Captain? Well, since I've already fulfilled some of mine, I thought I'd help you achieve yours!
B-become tastier! Coochie woochie, boing! Ugh, I wanna crawl into a hole and die!
At this rate, I might actually turn into a real maid.

*Sigh*... Do you really like maids that much, Master Captain?
Well, seeing you enjoy yourself so much makes me happy too.
The Pirate Cafe is recruiting crew members right now!

Treasure and honor! And above all... adventure!
Join the Mast Pirate Crew right now!
Maid? How in the world could you possibly think I look like a maid? I'm not going to be reciting any ridiculous "fluffy wuffy" spells!
The legendary pirate Mast has arrived!
I'm overflowing with dreams!
I feel like setting off on an adventure right this instant!
As expected, you really know your stuff, Master Captain!
Thank you, Master Captain.
Is this for me? I'll have to repay you somehow.
Technically, I was told not to accept gifts... but hey, as long as it's something good, I don't see the problem!
You may be mischievous at times, Master Captain, but... you're not so bad yourself.

Shall we have a drink together?
I'll pour one for you. After all, I am a maid.

What are your dreams, Master Captain?
Actually, hold on. I think I already know.
Is it time to set sail?
Aye aye, Master Captain.
Follow the wind, follow the adventure.
All hands to battle stations!
Run before the wind, full speed ahead!
The big one is mine!
No one can stop us!
Charging up adventure power!
I'll go at an easy pace.
Just a tiny sip of rum.
Ready to stir up some chaos!
Have a taste of adventure!
Wipe them all out, for the sake of adventure!
Yo-ho-ho!
Done!
You all are sleeping with the fish!
Ugh.
Ahh!
Argh!
Adventure... never dies...
Victory! Let's crack open some rum to celebrate!
The cafe's nice and spacious! It'd make the perfect pirate cafe, if you catch my drift...
Y'know, our drinks would taste better if we used rum instead of tea or coffee...
I'm gonna learn all the good recipes here and use 'em back at our cafe!
It's not on the menu, but I whipped up a special pirate dessert set just for you, Master Captain. You're gonna love it.
Here's the coffee you ordered! Aaand here's some rum on the house!
What...? Th-the spell to make your food delicious...?! I-I can't do that! Especially not here, of all places!
There were so many customers today... I need a moment to catch my breath.
Working here ain't bad, but I do miss the old place, and all the dreams I had there with you, Master Captain.
Today I'm working out here for a little while!
Ahoy there! Any interest in becoming a pirate with me?
The cafe's so packed that I don't really have time to be chatting...!
Come on in! I'll show you to your seat.
I feel like I could set sail right away!
I've gotten a little too good at serving... At this rate, I might actually end up becoming a pro maid...
I think it's finally time I showed you my true strength as a pirate...
I like this! I bet it'd look good on display at the cafe.
Thanks as always, Master Captain.
Th-this is too much... Are you sure I can have it?!
Wanna grab a bottle of rum with me after I'm done at the cafe?
Master Captain, what would you say to leaving with me to sail after our dreams?
You sure know how to get a person's heart racing, Master Captain.
Set sail!
Ahoy!
Hoist the sails!
Drop anchor!
This won't even whet my appetite!
Let's have ourselves a blast!
You dare stand in a pirate's way?
I'm gonna have a quick drink.
This fight's getting a bit long.
Time to hide for a sec, Morgan.
Order's ready!
I brewed it extra strong... Drink up.
Drink every last drop!
Piece of cake!
Who's next?
This is too easy!
Ouch!
Argh...!
Urgh...!
I can't... go down here... Not like this... urk!
Drinks are on me today! Let's drink 'til we drop! Hahaha!
